purpose: Determine whether the nine localized S10 low-clearance route poses admit a floor-following sensor height without changing topology, centerline or the 0.8m clearance threshold.

approval.scope: One read-only S10 C08 local floor-following pose feasibility audit over 9 route failures x 61 z offsets; zero inference, graph, training, C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the localized floor-following feasibility recommendation and then replied 继续 while the exact 9x61 implementation was being frozen.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only research audit of sealed generated assets.

sampling.rule: Retain all nine route-failure records, including reverse-traversal repeats. At each fixed x/y evaluate sensor z offsets -1.00 through +2.00m in exact 0.05m steps: 61 parameter candidates, 720 horizontal rays and one upward/downward ray each. Parameter candidates are not independent samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Sealed mesh first-hit geometry defines horizontal/up/down distances.
teacher.valid_mask: Feasible iff horizontal>=0.8m, downward distance in [0.95,1.05]m, upward>=0.8m and both vertical hits are within 8m.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Local diagnostic only; no trajectory is rewritten and no planner/model consumes the result.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only S10 C08 mesh and prior C08 audit CSV are opened; C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D, 395,280 horizontal and 1,098 vertical rays; expected seconds.

evidence.machine_metrics: 549-row candidate CSV, nine pose feasible intervals/recommendations and physical grouping.
evidence.complete_visual_review: One height-feasibility figure per physical group showing horizontal/down/up curves.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop on hash/count/nonfinite evidence/forbidden-read loss; do not stop when no feasible height exists because that is a valid diagnostic conclusion.
